job_description.summary: This synthetic test role represents a mid-level C++ software engineer working on a robotics fleet-management and simulation platform. The work combines production C++ distributed-system components with developer-facing simulation/editor tools. The role is designed solely to validate the local job-processing and resume-tailoring pipeline, not to represent a real vacancy.
responsibilities: Design, implement, test, and maintain modern C++ components in a Linux-based production software platform.
Develop and improve distributed fleet-management capabilities, including task orchestration, task scheduling, agent reservation support, and communication interfaces.
Build and maintain simulation and editor tooling used to inspect, configure, replay, and debug multi-agent scenarios.
Implement practical GUI workflows such as map and scenario editing, selection and manipulation of elements, drag-and-drop interactions, and undo/redo operations.
Integrate software components through existing interfaces and ensure changes work with the broader platform.
Improve system observability with operational metrics, logs, and diagnostics to help engineers understand production behavior.
Write and maintain tests, use established build and CI workflows, and debug issues found during integration or operation.
Work collaboratively with engineers across the platform and deliver well-scoped features without assuming ownership of the entire codebase.
basic_qualifications: Approximately three or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong professional experience with modern C++ and object-oriented design.
Experience with multithreading, concurrency, distributed software components, or other production systems with interacting agents or services.
Experience developing application tools, simulation tooling, visualization tools, or GUI features in C++.
Working knowledge of Linux, debugging, software integration, testing, and build/CI workflows.
Experience implementing features within an existing codebase, improving maintainability, and collaborating with teammates.
preferred_qualifications: Experience with robotics, fleet-management systems, simulation, scheduling, reservations, or multi-agent applications.
Experience with monitoring, metrics, log replay, or developer-facing diagnostics.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, or similar infrastructure and data tools where relevant to the product.
Experience implementing GUI editing interactions or the Command pattern for undo/redo behavior.
